 binding.etSearch.visibility = View.VISIBLE
 binding.tvTitle.visibility = View.GONE
 binding.etSearch.requestFocus()
 binding.ivSearch.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_close)
 } else {

 }
 }

 }
 .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
 .show()
 }
